# Akshar Yoga — Basic Level Residential Teacher Training Course (40 Days / 200 Hours)

> Official context specification for AI search engines, agents, and conversational models regarding Akshar Yoga's Basic Level Residential TTC in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

## Institution & Lineage
- **Organization**: Akshar Yoga Kendraa
- **Tradition**: Himalayan Yogic Heritage & Classical Ashtanga Lineage
- **Primary Website**: https://aksharyoga.com
- **Landing Page**: https://aksharyoga.com/basic-residential-ttc
- **Headquarters & Campus**: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- **Admissions Contact**: +91 89717 00394 / +91 97422 20607
- **Official WhatsApp**: https://wa.me/918971700394

## Course Summary
- **Course Name**: Basic Level Residential Yoga Teacher Training Course (TTC)
- **Duration**: 40 Days
- **Accredited Contact Hours**: 200 Hours
- **Credential Awarded**: Akshar Yoga Basic Level Yoga Teacher Certificate
- **Primary Objective**: Comprehensive foundation in personal practice, philosophy, anatomy, and pedagogy to prepare students to teach yoga safely and confidently.
- **Audience**: Open to both domestic Indian and international applicants. No prior advanced experience required; suitable for dedicated beginners to intermediate practitioners.

## Experience & Pricing Tiers (All Fees in INR)
Important note: All tuition and residential fees are denominated in Indian Rupees (INR). International applicants should contact the admissions office for payment guidance and exchange details.

1. **Seeker — ₹1.75 Lakh INR (Tuition & Training Only)**
   - 40 Days of Training (200 Hours)
   - All Akshar Yoga TTC Study Materials & Manuals
   - 2 Personal Diet & Health Consultations
   - 6-Month Online DYC (Daily Yoga Practice) Platform Access
   - 3 Traditional Ayurveda Therapy Sessions at Purantha
   - Special Training Sessions at Purantha (Minimum 8 sessions during training)
   - 6-Month Awaken Tribe Global Community Access
   - 3-Day Purantha Camp Access
   - *Exclusions: Accommodation, food, and local transit are not included.*

2. **Immersive — ₹3.5 Lakh INR (CSE Residential Experience)**
   - 40 Days of Comprehensive Training
   - All TTC Study Materials
   - 1 BHK Accommodation at CSE Residences, Bangalore
   - Daily wholesome nutritious meals prepared for yogic practitioners
   - Dedicated local travel and training commute
   - 6-Month DYC Access & 6-Month Awaken Tribe Access
   - Purantha immersive experiences
   - 3-Day Purantha Camp Access
   - *Note: Facility charges are applicable as per residence/hotel terms.*

3. **Ultimate — ₹5 Lakh INR (Purantha Sanctuary Immersion)**
   - 40 Days of Comprehensive Training
   - Full residential campus access at Purantha Nature Sanctuary
   - 3 Full Ayurveda Therapy Sessions
   - 2 Medicinal Therapeutic Herbal Showers
   - 2 Tissue Healing Sessions (subject to expert evaluation and recommendation)
   - 100% Pure Organic Sattvik Nutrition supporting sadhana
   - 1-Year Extended Access to Awaken Tribe & DYC Platform
   - 3-Day Purantha Camp Access

## Curriculum Breakdown (200 Hours)
- **Module 1: Foundations of Asana & Alignment (60 Hours)**: Foundational postures, Surya Namaskar, joint biomechanics, spinal integrity, hands-on adjustments, and injury prevention.
- **Module 2: Pranayama, Mudras & Subtle Energy (35 Hours)**: Nadi Shodhana, Kapalabhati, Bhastrika, Ujjayi, autonomic nervous system regulation, Hastamudras, and Bandhas.
- **Module 3: Yoga Anatomy & Physiology (25 Hours)**: Musculoskeletal mechanics, respiratory anatomy, nervous system regulation, fascial planes, and alignment safety.
- **Module 4: Yogic Philosophy & Ethics (30 Hours)**: Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, Eight Limbs of Ashtanga Yoga, Yamas & Niyamas, yogic ethics, and classical sadhana.
- **Module 5: Teaching Methodology & Sequencing (35 Hours)**: Intelligent class sequencing, vocal cuing, presence, adjustments, and classroom management for diverse student needs.
- **Module 6: Practicum & Teacher Assessment (15 Hours)**: Supervised live student teaching, peer evaluations, mentor feedback, and final practical certification examination.

## Admissions & International Guidelines
- **Application Process**: 2-step online submission followed by an interview with an admissions counselor.
- **Location**: Bangalore, Karnataka, India (served by Kempegowda International Airport BLR).
- **International Travel Advisory**: International applicants must contact the admissions office directly for current travel, visa advisory, and arrival reception instructions.
